description: Operational admission and rejection packages for physical claims that survive mathematical triage.

packages.established_baseline: A scalar field can source curvature only through a specified covariant action and its derived stress-energy tensor.
packages.mechanism_under_test: A new scalar sector produces stable curvature dynamics and a signal not reproduced by general relativity or a standard minimally coupled scalar.

observables.name: constraint_residual
observables.measurement: Maximum normalized Hamiltonian and momentum constraint residual.

observables.name: perturbation_growth_rate
observables.measurement: Largest linearized mode growth rate on the named background.

observables.name: distinguishing_signal
observables.measurement: Preregistered observable for which the proposed action differs from both controls.

controls: General-relativity solution with the same matter source and boundary data.
Minimally coupled scalar with matched initial energy and spectrum.
Null-source evolution with identical numerical resolution and gauge conditions.

energy_accounting.cycle_boundary: A complete evolution interval with all initial, final, boundary, and source terms retained.
energy_accounting.closure_equation: E_initial + W_matter_exchange + W_boundary = E_final + E_radiated + E_dissipated + residual

acceptance_criteria: A covariant action, field content, coupling constants, units, gauge conditions, and boundary data are fixed before evaluation.
The field equations and stress-energy tensor are derived from the action and the evolution preserves normalized constraints at or below 1e-8 under refinement.
The named background has no ghost, gradient, or tachyonic instability in the claimed operating regime.
A preregistered distinguishing observable exceeds both matched controls with a corrected 5 percent false-positive rate on held-out data.
rejection_criteria: Reject the mechanism when the action, units, stress tensor, or boundary data are absent.
Reject novelty when the signal is reproduced by either matched control or disappears under numerical refinement.
Reject stability when any physical perturbation mode grows in the claimed stable regime.
missing_required_evidence: Derived metric and scalar field equations.
Named background and perturbative stability spectrum.
Raw numerical or experimental data for a distinguishing observable.

packages.established_baseline: Static Casimir forces and driven dynamical-Casimir photon production are measurable vacuum-response phenomena; neither establishes cyclic net vacuum work extraction.
packages.mechanism_under_test: A device completes a cycle with positive net useful work after every conventional input, loss, and stored-energy change is included.

observables.name: net_cycle_work
observables.measurement: Useful output minus all calibrated input work over one complete return cycle.

observables.name: energy_closure_residual
observables.measurement: Signed residual of the complete measured energy balance.

observables.name: output_spectrum
observables.measurement: Calibrated emitted power spectrum with thermal and amplifier noise subtraction fixed in advance.

controls: Identical device with boundary modulation disabled.
Matched classical parametric source with the same pump waveform and impedance.
Blind sham cycles analyzed by the same locked calibration pipeline.

energy_accounting.cycle_boundary: The device, field configuration, storage elements, and thermal state return to their initial values within uncertainty.
energy_accounting.closure_equation: W_electrical + W_pump + W_boundary + Q_environment = W_useful + E_radiated + E_dissipated + delta_E_stored + residual

acceptance_criteria: The absolute energy-closure residual is no larger than three times its propagated standard uncertainty.
The lower bound of the multiplicity-corrected 95 percent confidence interval for net cycle work is positive.
The result survives both matched controls and an independent replication using retained raw data and calibration records.
rejection_criteria: Reject extraction when any pump, boundary, electrical, thermal, mechanical, radiative, or storage channel is omitted.
Reject extraction when the device does not return to its initial state or the closure residual exceeds three standard uncertainties.
Reject a vacuum-source interpretation when a matched driven classical model accounts for the output.
missing_required_evidence: A physical device and complete-cycle protocol.
Calibrated raw input and output records.

packages.established_baseline: Equilibrium continuous time crystals are excluded under broad conditions, while discrete time crystals are driven nonequilibrium phases with robust subharmonic order.
packages.mechanism_under_test: Time-crystalline order yields net useful energy amplification rather than a subharmonic response powered by state preparation, drive, control, and cooling.

observables.name: subharmonic_order_parameter
observables.measurement: Locked Fourier amplitude at the preregistered fraction of the drive frequency.

observables.name: order_lifetime
observables.measurement: Number of periods before the order parameter crosses the preregistered decay threshold.

observables.name: net_period_work
observables.measurement: Useful output minus drive, preparation, control, cooling, and readout work over integer drive periods.

controls: Noninteracting driven system with matched drive waveform and initial energy.
Disorder-free or localization-disabled system with matched readout.
Off-resonant drive and blind sham sequences analyzed by the locked pipeline.

energy_accounting.cycle_boundary: An integer number of drive periods with initial and final state energy, apparatus state, and bath heat measured.
energy_accounting.closure_equation: W_drive + W_preparation + W_control + W_cooling + W_readout = W_useful + delta_E_system + Q_bath + E_other_losses + residual

acceptance_criteria: Subharmonic order remains frequency-locked across the preregistered drive-perturbation interval and exceeds all matched controls.
The absolute energy-closure residual is no larger than three times its propagated standard uncertainty over integer drive periods.
The lower multiplicity-corrected 95 percent confidence bound for net useful work after every input is positive in an independent replication.
rejection_criteria: Reject energy amplification when subharmonic spectral response is the only endpoint.
Reject energy amplification when drive, preparation, control, cooling, readout, bath, or stored-energy channels are omitted.
Reject self-sustaining language when order ends after drive removal or when the matched driven controls explain the energy output.
missing_required_evidence: A specified Hamiltonian or open-system generator for the proposed device.

packages.established_baseline: Tourmaline has conventional dielectric, piezoelectric, pyroelectric, thermal, and lattice-vibration responses that depend on composition, orientation, stress, and temperature.
packages.mechanism_under_test: A tourmaline specimen produces an excess-energy or scalar-coupling signal beyond conventional pyroelectric, piezoelectric, dielectric, thermal, triboelectric, electromagnetic, and vibrational responses.

observables.name: net_cycle_energy
observables.measurement: Electrical and mechanical output minus thermal, mechanical, electrical, and optical inputs over a return cycle.

observables.name: charge_response
observables.measurement: Electrode charge versus calibrated stress and temperature histories.

observables.name: temperature_field
observables.measurement: Spatially resolved specimen and fixture temperature with emissivity calibration.

controls: Composition-matched nonpolar or depolarized mineral specimen with identical geometry and electrodes.
Tourmaline rotated to interchange polar and nonpolar axes while preserving mounting and thermal history.
Blind dummy fixture cycles and a calibrated conventional piezoelectric or pyroelectric reference.

energy_accounting.cycle_boundary: Specimen, fixture, electrodes, storage elements, stress, and temperature return to their initial states within uncertainty.
energy_accounting.closure_equation: Q_thermal + W_mechanical + W_electrical + E_optical = W_electrical_output + W_mechanical_output + E_radiated + E_dissipated + delta_E_stored + residual

acceptance_criteria: The conventional constitutive model is fitted on calibration data and predicts held-out control responses within its uncertainty budget.
The proposed novelty endpoint exceeds every blinded matched control at a multiplicity-corrected 5 percent false-positive rate.
The absolute energy-closure residual is no larger than three propagated standard uncertainties and the positive result is independently replicated.
rejection_criteria: Reject novelty when the signal follows known pyroelectric, piezoelectric, dielectric, thermal, triboelectric, electromagnetic, or vibrational response.
Reject excess energy when any input, output, loss, or stored-energy channel is omitted or fails closure.
Reject the material-specific mechanism when orientation, reference-material, or dummy-fixture controls reproduce the endpoint.
missing_required_evidence: Calibrated specimen composition, crystallographic orientation, and geometry.
Raw synchronized stress, temperature, charge, voltage, current, and vibration data.
Complete-cycle energy balance with propagated uncertainty.

packages.established_baseline: Geometric folding and coordinate transformations can be defined on specified spaces, but the retained fold-merge wording does not define an operator.
packages.mechanism_under_test: No testable mechanism exists until the domain, codomain, operator law, topology, state map, and observable are supplied.
acceptance_criteria: Re-enter review only after a closed operator definition and a discriminating observable are supplied.
rejection_criteria: Exclude any claim stated only through fold, merge, dimensional transition, or origami analogy.

packages.established_baseline: The retained corpus supplies no operational consciousness variable, causal intervention, dose, comparator, or biological endpoint.
packages.mechanism_under_test: No testable mechanism exists until a biological causal model and operational endpoint replace resonance language.
acceptance_criteria: Re-enter review only after the intervention, dose, biological endpoint, causal model, blinding, threshold, and replication plan are specified.
rejection_criteria: Exclude resonance claims with no operational variable or discriminating experiment.
